metadata.title: A Day in a Kashmiri Village I Part - 2/3
metadata.description:
Agar firdous baroiye zameen ast, hame asto, hame asto, hame ast!!! If there is paradise on earth, it is here! It is here! It is here! 

To experience the traditional and the laid back lifestyle of kashmiris, a visit to the picturesque Kashmiri villages is a must. It is in these small hamlets that you get the taste of the real Kashmir and an understanding of why kashmiris are famous worldwide as fabulous hosts. To experience a day like true locals, we visited Ratnipora, a scenic village located in south Kashmir.

Watch the video to experience A Day in a Kashmiri Village

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
